notes: Turn 1 was strong (Jailbreak steal of Hybrid Release, Transfer of Wealth steal of Longevity Serum), but after Anemone emptied the grip the Runner spent its last click on an R&D run instead of drawing, ending at 0 cards against a Jinteki deck and getting flatlined by Mindscaping on Corp turn 2.

Won by slowly scoring Project Ingatan x2 and Megaprix Qualifier behind Ablative Barrier, but the economy sat at 0-3 credits almost all game (Nico Campaigns trashed repeatedly), HQ's single ice was never rezzed, and Superconducting Hub (T9) and Architect Deployment Test (T11) were stolen from an open HQ; T4 and T10/T13 were all-credit-click turns.

After stealing Above the Law and Transport Monopoly from open HQ on T1, the Runner clicked for credits nearly every click from T6 to T27, banking 84 credits with no breakers beyond Boi-tata and only occasional runs, letting Weyland score Transport Monopoly (T6), Divested Trust x2 (T25/T27) and Transport Monopoly (T28) while sitting at 6 points.

Solid scoring line (Superconducting Hub, Megaprix x2, Architect Deployment Test, Melies via Seamless Launch T13) behind Hagen/Drafter, though R&D was left behind a single Wave while the Runner ran it 4 times a turn from T3-T8 (Project Ingatan stolen T4) and the Corp drifted to 0 credits on T4-T5.

Won thanks to a stalled Corp, but ran Server 2 into the known, unbreakable Saisentan again on T4 and T6 with no breaker, losing 9 more cards (Sure Gamble, Jailbreak, Lie Low etc.) for nothing, after the T2 facecheck had already cost Red Team; only installing Revolver on T7 turned it around.

HQ was protected only by Drafter (no ETR) all game and Server 2 agendas were installed behind ice the Corp could not afford to rez (Project Ingatan stolen T8, Megaprix T12 and T20); from T15-T24 the Corp sat on 11-24 credits clicking for credits and discarding instead of icing HQ, and lost to Project Ingatan stolen from HQ on T24.

Good early punishment of naked Above the Laws (T4) and steady Buzzsaw/Leech R&D pressure won it, but the Runner facechecked Archives into Hammer at 1 credit on T15 (losing Bling and Leech), ran a 4-ice Server 4 with 2 credits on T17 (losing Boi-tata), then ran Archives into the known Hammer again (losing Gachapon).

Repeated single-access R&D runs that could only see the same top card (T1-T6), then from T7 to T13 did nothing but click for credits up to 33 while Weyland advanced and scored Transport Monopoly (T5) and Above the Law (T12, T14) in remotes it never contested.

Kept agendas in HQ behind only Grubber (2 bad publicity that subsidised the Runner) while building a 4-ice Server 1 it left empty until T13, so Tomorrow's Headline was stolen from HQ on T10, T15 and T16; Embedded Reporting went into a fresh Paywall-only Server 2 (stolen T14) and many turns were credit/draw clicks with discards at 10-15 credits.

Coherent NBN plan with Spin Doctor/Federal Fundraising economy and scoring Post-Truth Dividend, Next Big Thing, Embedded Reporting and Tomorrow's Headline behind Mestnichestvo; minor oddities were the all-credit T4, repeated end-of-turn discards (T8-T11) and spending NBT to shuffle away the entire hand on T12.

Spent all 5 credits rezzing Mestnichestvo on HQ on T1, leaving the Server 1 ice unrezzable so Embedded Reporting was stolen immediately; later scores were fine, but T9-T14 drifted with credit clicks and ice on an unused Server 2 against a passive Runner.

Kept bouncing off the recycled Descent on Server 2 (T5-T7) with no way to break it, and on T11 spent its clicks on R&D/HQ (good SDS steal) instead of checking the twice-advanced card in Server 2, which the Corp then scored as SDS Drone Deployment for the win on T12.

Left Post-Truth Dividend and Tomorrow's Headline in HQ for the Runner's T2 runs, installed Next Big Thing at 0 credits behind unrezzable ice on T5 (stolen), wasted T7-T9 clicks and credits trashing Daily Casts while broke, then repeated the mistake by installing NBT with 1 credit on T11 (stolen for the loss).

Won through persistent R&D pressure and the Archives check (Project Yagi-Uda T12), but T3-T7 were full of repeat single-access R&D runs through Konjin that could only re-see the same top card, and it ran a naked advanced Urtica Cipher on T9 down to 0 cards against Jinteki.

Reasonable pressure (good Archives check on T4 for Hybrid Release and Longevity Serum, Revolver on Karuna, Docklands win on T16), but it kept taking Anemone damage on R&D and facechecked Server 1's Anemone on T5 losing Red Team, and ran advanced Urtica Cipher on T12 down to 0 cards.

After an early ADT score, the Corp stopped developing: from T10 to T15 it clicked for credits up to 27 with a full hand (discarding each turn) while HQ had just Bloop and agendas, so Megaprix (T9) and Project Ingatan (T15) were stolen from HQ while a 4-ice Server 2 sat empty.

Spent 7 of its 9 starting credits on Boi-tata and Banner T1 and never recovered, repeatedly running HQ through Afshar and losing 2 credits each time while broke (T7-T15), so it could never contest Server 2 as Weyland scored Transport Monopoly, Above the Law and SDS Drone Deployment.

Fast start (Melies T5, ADT T6) but R&D was guarded only by a non-ETR Wave all game and HQ by Ansel alone; with 15-24 credits on T7-T9 the Corp drew and clicked for credits instead of icing centrals, losing Project Ingatan from HQ (T8) and three R&D agendas to lose on T9.

Against a Runner that mostly clicked for credits, the Corp also clicked for credits most of the game up to 46 credits, discarded agendas to an unprotected Archives (Project Ingatan and Superconducting Hub stolen T22, Ingatan again T31), scored only 3 points and decked out on T36.

Clicked for credits almost every click from T2 to T21 (banking 55) with only Boi-tata installed, ignoring advanced cards in Server 2/3 so Weyland scored Above the Law (T8, T20), Divested Trust (T13) and Transport Monopoly (T15, T22) uncontested; the one rich run on T18 shows it could have contested them.
